summary: Bounded Writer paragraph removal preserves the non-empty body invariant and existing browser behavior.
findings: No confirmed defects: the domain rejects invalid removal, UI exposes removal only when eligible, history restores removed content, and plain-text export reflects the reduced body.
evidence_refs: fast contour passed: format, lint, typecheck, JSDoc, 41 application tests, 100% coverage
ap doctor and routing validation passed
residual_risks: Playwright, static smoke, inventory tests, and full verification remain deferred under the user-approved cadence. Range deletion, rich text, reordering, layout, ODT, PDF, and broad Writer parity remain separate tasks.
